archetypes.name: shell-git
archetypes.rationale: Bash restore logic changed from archive/tar to ls-tree/show under strict shell semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the Bash snapshot-restore path, especially git ref selection, NUL-delimited enumeration, per-file git show extraction, tmp cleanup, and behavior under set -euo pipefail. Look for cases where git failures, empty snapshots, odd filenames, or partial restores produce the wrong structured status or leave inconsistent local state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pause-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes durable pause marker retention/deletion behavior across GitHub issue state and local resume state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the pause/resume marker lifecycle end to end, including keep-on-failure, delete-after-success, marker-delete failure warnings, body drift, and .resume-loaded handling. Check whether retry, crash, stale-marker, and collaborator-edited-marker scenarios remain coherent for operators. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ship-resume
archetypes.rationale: Large Python changes add persisted ship/CI resume counters, phases, durable flags, and PR state recovery.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python ship resume state machine, focusing on how counters, durable flags, PR numbers, branch names, merge results, resume phases, and caller kinds flow through fresh, stalled, out-of-scope, CI, and merge paths. Look for state transitions that could resume at the wrong phase, lose progress, repeat side effects, or mis-handle merged versus open PRs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: state-validation
archetypes.rationale: New persisted state parsing and validation paths consume repo/session files that may be stale or malformed.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect new state-file parsing, validation, and fallback behavior for untrusted or corrupt persisted values. Pay special attention to branch names, PR URLs, repo slugs, conflict file CSVs, booleans, integer counters, manifest status reads, and any paths where invalid state could influence commands or public output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: The change updates implementation scripts, docs, security notes, and harnesses with closely coupled contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the behavior implemented in scripts and Python against the updated markdown contracts, SECURITY text, plan acceptance criteria, and regression harness expectations. Look for mismatches in status tokens, warnings, marker semantics, accepted sentinel names, documented failure modes, and test coverage claims. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
